verdict.rationale: Notte has dedicated integration pages for CrewAI and the Vercel AI SDK, both connecting through the official Notte MCP server, plus Claude-oriented guides that drive browsers through the Notte CLI and an OpenAI CUA guide. That covers most of the named frameworks with documented adapters. These are MCP/CLI bridges rather than native framework packages, and the snippets are thin. Missing for 10: any LangChain integration, an explicit Claude Agent SDK adapter (only Claude managed agents/Claude Code are shown), native framework-specific adapter libraries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
